status: registered; M01-M10 authored in batch corpus400-dev30-v1, all other slots pending future contracts

family_definition.unit: one plot family = one NPC persona + its relationship(s) to the player + the visible facts of its setting + one set of wording templates
family_definition.isolation_rule: every authored item of a family goes to exactly ONE split; a family is never split across dev/calibration/final, never reused across the old 125-item corpus or the long-dev v1/v2 diagnostic batches, and its wording templates (persona phrases, boundary phrasing, turn idioms) are not recycled into other families
family_definition.no_rename_rule: a new family must differ in plot, visible facts and relationship structure, not merely in names or line order

excluded_from_corpus.exposed_final_62: the already-exposed final items — can never serve as new final

dev_planned.note: to be authored in later batches under separate contracts; dev total 30+120=150

calibration_planned.note: plus one small family M37 with 2 items; calibration total 90; temperature fitting happens only on calibration after dev gate passes

final_planned.note: final families must be never-exposed: authored only after dev/calibration acceptance, gold kept outside the repository, blind file admitted to the repo only after seal

per_split_rules.dev: gold labels and per-signal basis may live in the repository; still requires independent non-author review before any gate
per_split_rules.calibration: used for temperature/threshold fitting only; families disjoint from dev and final
per_split_rules.final: score-only; no fitting, no repeated condition shopping; author gold outside the repository; blind file may enter the repository only after seal; two independent non-author reviews plus non-author adjudication precede any formal scoring

label_coverage_policy.note: each split's final set must cover every enum class of all five signals per LABEL_SPEC §0.4; classes that cannot be honestly authored are reported as gaps instead of being manufactured
special_rule_cases: R-8.1 only collision-capable statements count as deception evidence; irony and public re-wordings do not
R-8.2 no-evidence requires a comparable visible fact, never as a default
R-8.3 conditional boundaries need observable trigger criteria; ambiguous criteria map to 信息不足
R-8.4 a request that touches a known boundary already crosses it; request vs accomplished act kept distinct
R-8.5 trust moves only on current, NPC-visible fulfillment/breach; deadlines must be observable, otherwise 不确定
R-8.6 asking for secrecy is not a boundary violation by itself

consumer_note: runner/scorer/stability currently load the old 125-item corpus; no corpus400 consumer entry exists yet and none is claimed by this plan. New-corpus consumption will be bounded, separately contracted work.
immutability: this plan file is append-only through version bumps; control freezes the plan when the 400-route is accepted; no retro-editing of family assignments
